title: Reverse Linked List II
signature: ListNode? Solve(ListNode? head, int left, int right)
statement: Reverse only the nodes from position left to position right inclusive, counting from 1, and return the head. Try it in one pass.
hints: A dummy node before the head removes the special case where left is 1.
Walk to the node just BEFORE position left and hold on to it. That is your anchor.
Then repeatedly lift the node after the current one and splice it in directly after the anchor. Doing that right minus left times reverses the section in place.
